name: MelBand RoFormer Kim | Vocals (Kimberley Jensen)
notes: Checkpoint SHA-256 and byte size are pinned from the upstream v0.1.5 checksum manifest.
Configuration is pinned to the upstream v0.1.5 source tag.
The model emits vocals; instrumental is computed as mixture minus vocals and is not a native model prediction.
Upstream inference does not resample input audio; this manifest therefore requires 44100 Hz input.
The upstream inference implementation duplicates mono input to stereo for inference and writes the vocal output back as mono.

name: HT-Demucs 6-stem (ONNX, StemSplit)
notes: Model assets are managed and cached by demucs-onnx through Hugging Face Hub; they are not downloaded through mseparate's SHA-pinned asset manager.
The ONNX backend uses ONNX Runtime CUDAExecutionProvider when CUDA is requested and fails rather than silently falling back to CPU.
The piano stem is experimental and may contain substantial bleed or artifacts; audition before relying on it.
The model emits six estimates from the full mix: drums, bass, other, vocals, guitar and piano.
mseparate converts input audio to 44100 Hz before inference and converts every output stem back to the original input sample rate; the original source file is never modified.
